test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 8th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

42, 24, 34, 43, ?, 89
solution:
**The pattern followed here is : Immediate next number is the reverse of the previous number.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53db50906cf07ad7c79f368f279bb4cd060a1caa078dda36f88f9744c0ff4f01.png] 

Hence, **"98"** is the correct answer.
